compiled_state.description:
## Observation

`fsck_tracker_health._tracker_sync_status` folds a `TimeoutExpired` from its own `_git` into a private synthetic `CompletedProcess(rc=124, "git timed out after 120s")`, then reads every non-zero return code as a semantic answer. When `git merge-base HEAD <remote>/<branch>` times out, fsck reports:

> DIVERGED: local 'tickets' branch shares no history with origin/tickets … Recover: run `rebar store fsck-recover`, or re-clone and re-init

and counts it as an issue. Measured 2026-11-02 PST with a scratch script: a healthy clone reports `(None, False)`; the same clone with only `merge-base` raising `TimeoutExpired` reports the DIVERGED line above with `is_issue=True`. `merge-base --is-ancestor` timing out is treated the same way (as "not an ancestor").

This is the same kind of misreport fixed for `sync._union_merge` in `painted-epidermal-shelduck`: a watchdog timeout rendered as a store-history verdict, with advice (fsck-recover, re-clone) that cannot fix a slow or wedged git call and, for "re-clone and re-init", risks discarding local-only commits.

## Scope notes

- The bound here is 120 s on history reads, not 30 s on index work, so the trigger is a wedged filesystem or very long history rather than index size. Not reproduced on a live tracker.
- It is one of several private rc-124 folds outside `rebar._store` (also `fsck_repair`, `_init_probe`, `_snapshot/git_fetch`, `_snapshot/ticket_receipt`). The `test_git_outcome` guard that keeps `gitutil.run_git_bounded` the sole constructor only scans `src/rebar/_store`, so these are not covered by it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A timed-out git call in `_tracker_sync_status` is reported as a timeout (operation and bound named), not as DIVERGED / not-an-ancestor, and is not counted as a divergence issue.
- [ ] The private timeout fold is replaced by `gitutil.run_git_bounded`, with `git_outcome.is_watchdog_timeout` used to recognise the outcome.
- [ ] A regression test drives `merge-base` to time out and asserts the report.
- [ ] The other private rc-124 folds listed above are checked for the same timeout-as-verdict shape and the result recorded here.
compiled_state.title: rebar store fsck reports a timed-out merge-base as DIVERGED (no shared history) and advises fsck-recover or re-clone
